blocks.html: Volunteer, shadow, or intern with the EduBud Community Center and be part of something meaningful! We offer flexible opportunities—whether you join us for a single community center event or a regular commitment—to match your schedule and skills. Our mission is to bring people with and without disabilities together, building authentic connections that enrich everyone. If this vision resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our community.
